going_concern.quote: Based on the Company’s current expected level of operating expenditures and the cash and cash equivalents on hand at March 31, 2024, management concludes that there is substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.equity_line: We have further agreed not to enter into an agreement involving a variable rate transaction until 12 months following the closing of the Transactions, provided however that the prohibition on “at-the-market offerings” and the issuance of common stock pursuant to an equity line of credit shall expire on the six-month anniversary of the closing date of this offering.
